title: Cowboy Spaghetti
description: A hearty and easy-to-make cowboy spaghetti with big chunks of meat and vegetables, simmered in a flavorful tomato broth.

ingredients.item: IGA crackers, bread crumbs, or grilled bread
Hot Rotel (diced tomatoes with green chilies)

steps: In a bowl, combine hamburger meat, eggs, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper, black pepper, salt, crackers or bread crumbs, and Tony's no salt seasoning. Mix thoroughly with your hand.
Form the mixture into meatballs of your desired size.
Place the meatballs in a pot and cover with beef broth. Bring to a boil and cook for 30 minutes.
After boiling, add Italian seasoning, chopped onions, portobello mushrooms, and celery to the pot.
Add whole tomatoes, fire roasted tomatoes, diced tomatoes with green chilies, tomato sauce, and tomato paste. Stir to combine.
Cover the pot with a lid and simmer until vegetables are tender and flavors meld, about 30 minutes.

Nutrition: Serving 1 bowl · Calories Approximately 400 kcal per serving · Fat 15g · Saturated fat 5g · Unsaturated fat 10g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 80mg · Sodium 800mg · Carbs 50g · Fiber 8g · Sugar 10g · Protein 25g

healthy: Lots of vegetables: onions, mushrooms, celery and several kinds of tomatoes.
Ground beef and eggs give protein.
Uses no salt seasoning for part of the flavor.
not_healthy: Two pounds of hamburger adds saturated fat.
Canned tomatoes, broth and salt add sodium.
Crackers or bread crumbs add refined carbs.
